journey.title: An operator declares a condition instead of remembering it
journey.purpose: The path that makes the scenario worth building. A condition written once, proven to parse, and checked against real facts before it is trusted — replacing a sentence in a document that nothing could evaluate.

steps.intent: Open the offer that is waiting on something and see it has no machine-evaluable trigger
Write the condition, and learn immediately where it does not parse and what the language admits
Dry-run it and discover a referenced fact does not exist yet — reported as unknown, not as unsatisfied
Supply the missing fact, dry-run again, and read a verdict that names every fact it used
Confirm the offer now states what it is waiting on, in the form the condition was declared
